target_customer: Adults with insomnia or sleep apnea who pay for online sleep care (originally consumers paying a meditation app subscription)
problem: Sleep care is hard to access, with long waits and in-person visits. Sleep Reset offers a digital clinic with CBT-I, at-home sleep testing and clinician-managed CPAP. At the YC batch the company was Simple Habit, a meditation app for stressed professionals.
business_model: Consumer subscription and clinical services (originally freemium meditation subscription at $11.99 per month)
product_category: Digital health, sleep care (previously meditation app)

founders.name: Yunha Kim
prior_employers: Investment banking in New York (YC launch post, no firm named)
education: Stanford GSB (postponed to run the company, per TechCrunch 2017)
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2016 and 2017, YC W17 launch post. YC page says Forbes 30 Under 30 and Stanford dropout headline.

competitors.name: Headspace
competitors.what: Guided meditation app with a single teacher voice

technical_complexity.rationale: Content marketplace apps on iOS, Android and web, standard engineering; later clinical care added regulatory and operational complexity.

defensibility.rationale: A multi-teacher marketplace was hard to copy quickly but Headspace and Calm had far more capital and content could be licensed by others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Calm and Headspace scaled with larger rounds and Apple announced Breathe in 2016. Simple Habit sold the app to Ingenio in March 2023 and focused on Sleep Reset.

market_need_then: Stress and meditation app demand was rising in 2016, with Headspace raising 30M in fall 2015 and Simple Habit reaching about 10,000 users at launch and 2.7 million total signups by November 2018.

branding.name_origin: Sleep Reset began as a program inside Simple Habit, inspired by users who struggled with sleep (founder blog). Simple Habit's origin is not stated.
branding.domain_note: Now thesleepreset.com, not the exact sleepreset.com.
branding.brand_signature: Spotify for mindfulness framing (YC launch title)

rebrands.why: After selling the Simple Habit app to Ingenio the company focused fully on Sleep Reset (founder blog, TechCrunch).

branding.community_and_virality: Simple Habit appeared on Shark Tank per Looper coverage; featured in Forbes, TechCrunch and Insider per the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Simple Habit had notable press and 2.7M signups but was overshadowed by Calm and Headspace; Sleep Reset is a clear descriptive name but newer.

pivots.why: Sleep content was about 10 percent of the library but 70 percent of engagement (TechCrunch 2023).

outcome_analysis: The YC W17 company was Simple Habit, a multi-teacher meditation marketplace that raised 2.5 million in 2017 and a 10 million Series A in 2018 from Foundation Capital. Competing against far larger Headspace and Calm, it shifted to a sleep program in 2022, sold the Simple Habit app to Ingenio in March 2023 and renamed the company Sleep Reset. It is active as a digital sleep clinic, a successful pivot with a modest capital base.
notes: The directory record describes Sleep Reset but the W17 batch company was Simple Habit. Exit is recorded as none because only the Simple Habit app was sold to Ingenio (March 2023, price undisclosed), not the company. Seed amount conflicts: TechCrunch 2.5M, VentureBeat 2.8M. Caplight lists a 3M round dated 2017-05-09 (aggregator). Any rounds after 2018 not found, so coverage is partial. Competitor sources are dated 2016-06, before the batch. The YC launch post is dated around January 2017. Blog post date of 2025 for the sale looks like a metadata error.
